data.summary: DX-agent-final-summary landed on main (e1574c74, merge gate passed) but a crash left it ABANDONED with a worktree holding 2 stale pin/merge commits. 'ddflow cleanup' lists it 'unmerged ... Finish it, or merge deliberately' with 0 safe actions, though the item's merge gate is done and the report says landed. Cleanup should recognise landed-on-main items with only pin/merge leftovers and offer removal; I removed worktree+branch by hand (leftover content stale vs main).
data.title: landed item stays abandoned; cleanup cannot retire its orphan worktree

'ddflow cleanup' lists it 'unmerged ... Finish it, or merge deliberately' with 0 safe actions, though the item's merge gate is done and the report says landed.
